claim: Bidirectional replication is a pair of rules: one from the source bucket to the bucket holding the replicas, and a second rule from that bucket back to the source; the buckets can be in the same or different Regions.
question: How do you set up bidirectional replication between a pair of S3 buckets?

evidence.quote: To set up two-way replication, create a replication rule from the source bucket (`{{amzn-s3-demo-source-bucket}}`) to the bucket containing the replicas (`{{amzn-s3-demo-destination-bucket}}`). Then, create a second replication rule from the bucket containing the replicas (`{{amzn-s3-demo-destination-bucket}}`) to the source bucket (`{{amzn-s3-demo-source-bucket}}`). The source and destination buckets can be in the same or different AWS Regions.
